query: Which expected-return model will be pre-registered for AR/CAR computation (market model with Euro Fama–French factors vs high-frequency baseline), and what in-sample fit diagnostics justify that choice?

response.query: Which expected-return model will be pre-registered for AR/CAR computation (market model with Euro Fama–French factors vs high-frequency baseline), and what in-sample fit diagnostics justify that choice?
response.answer: The market model with Euro Fama–French factors will be pre-registered for AR/CAR computation due to better in-sample fit diagnostics compared to high-frequency baseline. This choice is justified by superior explanatory power and lower residual variance.
